reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, isDailyWeekendSkip and getDateWithSkippedWeekend helpers, but does not factor out the per-occurrence weekend dispatch it shares with getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The 'daily skip drops weekends, otherwise skipWeekend moves the date' dispatch and the RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffold are restated from getUpcomingDates rather than shared.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered in the existing handler map and app.method list.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Readable and well-commented (the two-day margin), but a future change to weekend handling must be applied in another copy of the dispatch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the shared weekend helpers; no abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts reshapes getUpcomingDates' isDailyWeekendSkip ? weekdays : (skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend : date) dispatch into a loop with continue.
